name: Cyfuse Biomedical K.K.
summary: Cyfuse Biomedical K.K., formed in 2010 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, develops, produces and distributes regenerative medicine solutions. It works on cell-based products for therapeutic regeneration, takes contract cell product research work, and offers Bio 3D Printers for tissue regeneration, including regenova, which stacks cells in three dimensions, and S-PIKE, which forms complex 3D structures from cells.
